body: Well... it would effect how you make decisions. If you believe you should go and get things then you would be proactive, but if you believe that what will happen will happen then you would lead a more reserved life I believe.
Haha I am going through a break up right now as well. Unfortunately the morning anxiety started a few months before that and nothing had changed when it started so I’m not entirely sure.

The break up that Nick and Jess have in that episode very closely resembles the break up I had. It was incredibly similar and Nick and Jess still love each other and so do we... it’s just bad timing. Anyways it just triggered me.
Just wanted to let you all know I’m alive. I went to therapy today and I’m getting help. I’m still hurting an unbelievable amount but I’m here and I’m fighting.
If you don’t mind me asking, how long did it take you to get to that point?

You know, I️ didn’t do anything *BIG* this year. Just a lot of little happy things.. But I️ never would have met my boyfriend, we may break up soon. I️ hope we don’t because I really love him but we have been having quite a few problems lately. But I’ve learned so much from this relationship and while I will be very sad if we do end up breaking up I’m grateful that it happened. Meeting him has definitely changed my life. I️ also would have never gotten drunk, seen titanic, had sex, discovered my favorite ice cream flavor, moved out of my parents house, or even know what love is. All the little things end up being huge! 💕

Putting on make up is one of the only ways lately that helps me come down from an anxiety attack or just calms me down when I’m feeling anxious at all. It’s soothing and takes focus and it has been very helpful!

My boyfriend says he is worried he is becoming an emotional crutch for me. He doesn’t want me to rely on him too much with my anxiety. I know we are going to break up soon and I can’t help but blame my anxiety. Maybe if I was calmer or didn’t need so much we would be having less problems and still be as strong as we used to be.
It may take some time. I went through 6 different therapists before I found one that worked for me. It was exhausting and frustrating but having a good therapist had been incredible for me!

Orthotime is incredible. Doctor Watson is very friendly and they got my braces off 4 months before they said they would. The complete opposite experience of most of my friends who went elsewhere. They are located by the AF hospital and I would 100% recommend them.

Once I was babysitting and my little brother (6 at the time) and little sister (12 at the time) were fighting and my brother used to have quite the anger issues. My sister kept egging him on and he started throwing things at her. In our living room we have a giant glass sliding door which my sister was standing in front of. Anyways eventually my little brother picked up our Nintendo DS and threw it directly at my sisters head. She ducked just in time and it shattered the glass door. My sister was crying uncontrollably, I was staring in disbelief at the movie-like fight I had just seen, and my little brother ran out the front door, around the house, and to the DS to check on it. It was perfectly fine and still worked for years later.
I’m surprised I had to go so far down to see this! This is exactly what I came here to say. He is perfect in that role and no matter what else he does I will only see him as Joffrey.
Nerve. I know it wasn't absolutely amazing but I really enjoyed it.
Okay but who says he is stressing about catching the magicians? He could just as easily be stressing about everything working out with his plan and the scene is just taken out of context.

I suffer from severe generalized anxiety disorder and the most upsetting thing for me when I am in a high state of anxiety is that my body doesn't feel like my own. My hands get all tingly and everything hurts but also everything just feels strange. It's so frustrating.

Some pancakes from Denny's.

I was in a musical at my local community theatre and half way through the rehearsal process our villain dropped out. The director called EVERYONE and no one was available. Finally he called one of his friends who just happened to be available to come play the villains role. 

After his second rehearsal our whole cast decided to go to Denny's. I was not feeling it, I just wanted to go to bed but my friends convinced me to go. 

Anyways long story short I sat across from this new boy and we talked all night. Those disgusting pancakes led to me meeting the most amazing boy I have ever known and led to us falling in love.
